text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I was sent a celestial globe... You are<n>the sender.
This is "Why"?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was a present from me!<n>Uni... Happy
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well... you often speak to the stars,<n>don't you? So I
thought, you must like<n>space!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative... Yes. When doing<n>Exchange, "Fun" is
created.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So you do! That's such a poetic way<n>to enjoy
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So, well... I tried emulating you, but I<n>feel like how
you do it is quite<n>different...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
During Exchange, one must adjust<n>for Parallax. It is
"Difficulty," yes?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, it's very difficult! That's why<n>I'd like to try
looking at the globe<n>together, if that's all right with
you...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to be able to see the world<n>as you
experience it! ...That's why I<n>decided on a celestial
globe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Neo Universe reporting desire to<n>Observation
with Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If we can Share at least somewhat... I<n>will become
"Happiness."
